test_title: PYST 33: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

OWES - WOES - OESW

LITE - ILTE - LTEI
solution:
The logic followed here is:

OWES - WOES - OESW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc93b780f5998ad2464ca66db3981001daf44ad6fff7b94deaeced31ca69117d.png] 

LITE - ILTE - LTEI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/753a04f230e105b00ce988b0e455291917e086384b71b4b7406b6bbd29d64d6a.png] 

Now, let's check each option:

1. JUTE - UJTE - EUTJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61618b20fe988e261301a27ba2009d48467365d2a33b3791c5152bd194eb0a8a.png] 

This group of triads does not follow the same logic.

2. VAST - VSAT - TSAV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11bb54caf33f8b1ab5b2d9a8d5d8a22d5bfcd717d179172d2b803f076ec1ac2b.png] 

This group of triads does not follow the same logic.

3. EARN - AERN - ERNA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fa2184099d28657c079cd4ff08447f1f2995e0be1bb00b69bd155464aa245fb.png] 

This group of triads follows the same logic.

4. PAIN - APIN - AINP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23260e9dd49e743ac511055353a2cc87323dc532bbd78de12169140500ba7180.png] 

This group of triads does not follow the same logic.

Thus, EARN - AERN - ERNA from the given options is the one which follows the same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
